sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface detection of the membrane-anchored receptor was enabled by anti-FLAG staining; the paper reports surface display of the tagged receptor. Function not explicitly assayed in L1.
sites.rationale: CLEC6A is a Type II transmembrane protein with its C-terminus in the extracellular space (residues 42–209). The ledger clip L1 explicitly describes a C-terminal (extracellular) FLAG tag on full-length, membrane-anchored Dectin-2, confirming the tag is on the extracellular face. Because the paper names only 'C-terminal' and not a specific residue, the junction is topology-derived as insert_after_residue=209 (residue L), the sole extracellular terminus. Computed distance from the TM boundary (residue 41) is 168 residues, well exceeding the ≥3-residue constraint. Full-length human Dectin-2 (CLEC6A) cloned into EMCV-SRα vector with a C-terminal (extracellular) FLAG epitope tag; construct is membrane-anchored and full-length. CLEC6A is a Type II single-pass TM protein (intracellular 1–22, TM 23–41, extracellular 42–209), so the C-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus. No specific residue number is cited; position 209 (L) is derived from the topology landmarks as the unique extracellular terminal junction.

sources.claim: Full‐length open‐reading frames of human Mincle (NM014358, bases 109‐766), DCIR (NM016184, bases 263‐974), or Dectin‐2 (NM001007033, bases 151‐778) were cloned in to the EMCV‐SRα vector followed by a C‐terminal (extracellular) FLAG epitope tag.

literature_notes: L2 and L3 both describe an N-terminal FLAG-tagged Dectin-2 construct. For a Type II transmembrane protein, the N-terminus (residues 1–22) is intracellular; an N-terminal tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. L3 reports surface detection by anti-FLAG staining of this construct, which is inconsistent with the authoritative topology (N-terminus intracellular). No explicit snorkel validation is described. Per the rules, a tag on an intracellular terminus without an explicit validated snorkel does not qualify as a surface site and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports an internal loop insertion for CLEC6A.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal FLAG tag on full-length Dectin-2; for a Type II TM protein the N-terminus (residues 1–22) is cytoplasmic, so this tag faces the intracellular compartment and is not a surface epitope site.
